---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help improve Sloppi methodology or code rules
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the Issue**
A clear and concise description of what design failure, broken link, or rule collision occurred.

**Affected Module / Subsystem**
- [ ] Research (`research/`)
- [ ] Content (`content/`)
- [ ] Design System (`design-system/`)
- [ ] Implementation (`implementation/`)
- [ ] Visual QA & Audit (`audit/`)
- [ ] Refinement (`refinement/`)
- [ ] Workflows & Checklists

**Expected Behavior**
What the Sloppi methodology should have guided the agent to do.

**Actual Behavior**
What the agent actually produced or where the instruction failed.

**Proposed Resolution**
Suggested minimal intervention or structural fix.
